description: An old, begrimed, and blistered blacksmith aboard the ship who patiently repairs weapons and tools for the crew despite a ruined past and physical affliction.
raw_features: Nearly sixty years old with a chronically broken back; Suffers from a painful yawing gait due to losing extremities of both feet to frostbite; Formerly a famed artisan who lost his home, family, and fortune to alcoholism; Operates a portable forge lashed to ringbolts by the foremast on deck

description: The captain of the ship, for whom Perth crafted or repaired an artificial leg.
raw_features: Recipient of Perth's contributory blacksmithing work

description: A metaphorical figure personifying alcoholism and addiction, which ruined Perth's family, career, and household.
raw_features: Metaphorical fiend representing alcoholism; Brought financial and personal ruin to Perth's life

description: Perth's blacksmithing equipment retained on the deck of the ship.
raw_features: Lashed to ringbolts by the foremast; Used for forging, altering, and repairing weapons like harpoons, lances, boat-spades, and pike-heads
